wiki.title: Taffy Howard
wiki.extract: Taffy D. Howard (née Chewning) is an American politician who has served in the South Dakota Senate representing the 34th district as a Republican since 2025. She previously served in the South Dakota House of Representatives, representing the 33rd district from 2017 to 2023. She unsuccessfully ran for the U.S. House to represent South Dakota's at-large congressional district in 2022.
